title: Two-open induction step for perfect-complex descent
statement: Let I be a directed preorder, (R_i) a directed system of Noetherian rings, c a colimit cocone, i an index and s:X_i → Spec R_i finitely presented. Let W be a quasi-compact open and V an affine open of X_i. If P(W) and P(V), then P(W ∪ V), for the explicitly fixed descent predicate [def-pc-perfect-descent-on-open]. No hypothesis of descent of objects on the intersection is needed: only descent of the overlap morphism is used.

source.place: Tag 09RF, proof: two-open gluing induction step (Tags 09RE, 079W, 08FE, 08DG)

proof.text: For an arbitrary presentation of W union V and perfect limit object E, apply perfect_descent_compatible_local_data. It supplies a stage j, a cover U,V, perfect local objects A,B, an overlap isomorphism e and compatible maps a,b into restrictions of Rg_*E, whose explicit local adjoints are invertible. Unfold the real predicate PerfectOpenGluingData; it contains no global object.

Apply derived_open_gluing on the stage cover to A,B,e. Its object clause gives F and identifications iU and iV. Its morphism clause applied to Rg_*E and the compatibility equation gives d:F to Rg_*E with restrictions iU.hom followed by a and iV.hom followed by b. At each point use local_perfect_of_openRestriction_iso on whichever member contains the point to obtain the ambient local perfect model; this proves IsPerfect F.

Let phi be the adjoint of d. Naturality of gamma identifies its restriction to U with gamma.hom(F), followed by the pullback of iU.hom, followed by the supplied invertible local adjoint of a. The private generic categorical helper isIso_restricted_adjoint proves this equality by cancelling gamma.hom and expanding Adjunction.homEquiv_symm_apply. The V calculation is identical. Inverse image preserves the covering union, so schemeDerived_isIso_of_openRestriction makes phi globally invertible. Return j,hij,F, its perfectness and asIso phi for the exact canonical map in PerfectDescentOnOpen.

lean.statement:
theorem perfect_descent_open_union
    {I : Type u} [Preorder I] [IsDirected I (· ≤ ·)]
    (R : I ⥤ CommRingCat.{u}) [∀ i : I, IsNoetherianRing (R.obj i)]
    (c : Cocone R) (hc : IsColimit c) (i : I) (Xi : Scheme.{u}) (s : Xi ⟶ Spec (R.obj i))
    [LocallyOfFinitePresentation s] [QuasiCompact s] [QuasiSeparated s]
    [∀ Z : Scheme.{u},
      HasDerivedCategory.{w} (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings Z.toRingedSpace))]
    [∀ (Z : Scheme.{u}) (U : Z.Opens),
      HasDerivedCategory.{w} (SheafOfModules.{u} ((moduleRings Z.toRingedSpace).over U))]
    (W V : Xi.Opens) (hW : IsCompact (W : Set Xi)) (hV : IsAffineOpen V)
    (dW : PerfectDescentOnOpen R c i Xi s W)
    (dV : PerfectDescentOnOpen R c i Xi s V) :
    PerfectDescentOnOpen R c i Xi s (W ⊔ V)
